name: GEMM-GS Blending
definition: A technique to reformulate the opacity computation in 3D Gaussian Splatting into a GEMM-compatible dot-product form to leverage GPU Tensor Cores, addressing the low compute efficiency of element-wise quadratic terms in standard blending.
summary: GEMM-GS Blending accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting by transforming quadratic opacity computations into linear dot products for efficient GPU matrix multiplication.
